card.name: Digit 1 or 2 starting a two-digit number
card.fires_on: A leading digit (mostly 1, sometimes 2) that begins a two-digit number whose next digit is still to come, as in 12 weeks, every 12 hours, or the year 1815.

modes.label: Twelve in dosing
modes.description: The digit 1 before a final 2 in durations or intervals such as 12 weeks or every 12 hours.

modes.label: Measurement value
modes.description: A leading digit of a number such as a pressure reading.

card.writes: It suppresses zero-like tokens, so the next digit is pushed away from 0.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a two-digit number like 12, where the second digit is not yet written.
